topic: City-run singles mixers: Seongnam 'Solomon's Choice' since July 2023 (29 events, 2,820 guests, 707 matched couples, 30 married or engaged, 9 births or pregnancies as of 2026-11-09), Seoul 'Seollem in Hangang' (3,286 applicants for 100 seats, ID/job/marriage-record checks and sex-crime record check), birth rate 0.80
title: In Korea, the City Sets You Up on a Date

slides.headline: In Korea, **the city** sets you up on a date.
slides.note: And half the guests leave as a couple.

slides.headline: Hosted by **city hall**
slides.body: Seongnam, a city just south of Seoul, has hosted singles' nights since July 2023. It calls them Solomon's Choice (솔로몬의 선택).

slides.headline: First, **the documents**
slides.body: Seoul's version asks for proof of address, proof of a job or income, and a family record showing you are single. Then the city checks for sex crimes.

slides.headline: 33 applicants for **every seat**
slides.body: In 2024, 3,286 people applied for 100 seats at Seoul's first riverside singles' night. Later rounds were just as full.

slides.headline: Talk, rotate, **then pick**
slides.body: Guests talk one-on-one and move from table to table. At the end, each one quietly picks a favorite. Only a mutual pick becomes a match.

slides.headline: Why a city **plays matchmaker**
slides.body: Korea's birth rate was 0.80 in 2025. Almost every baby here is born to a married couple, so cities are starting one step earlier.

slides.headline: From first date **to wedding**
slides.body: Of Seongnam's matches, 30 couples have married or are about to. Nine babies have been born or are on the way.

slides.headline: Couples matched in Seongnam **since 2023**
slides.body: From 2,820 guests over 29 nights. About one in two.

slides.headline: Sweet, or **a bit strange?**
slides.body: Critics say dating is private and the money belongs in housing and childcare. Fans say it is a cheap, safe way to meet someone real.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: A softly lit party venue with small tables and candles, blurred behind the text.
slides.design_note: Use the account's established CTA treatment and amber highlight.

caption:
In Korea, some cities run their own singles' nights. You send in your documents, the city checks them, and then you get a seat.

In Seongnam, about half the guests leave as a couple, and 30 couples have married so far.

Would you sign up if your city ran one?
reply: One more thing: it is not only Seoul and Seongnam. Many Korean cities, and even some companies, now run singles' nights of their own. Would you trust your city to pick your date?
fact_check: 3장: 서울시 '설렘, in 한강' 제출서류 주민등록초본·재직증명서/사업자등록증명원/소득금액증명서 택1·혼인관계증명서(상세), 성범죄 이력 조회(서울 미디어허브, YTN 2024-11-07).
5장: 1:1 대화 로테이션 후 최종 선택, 서로 고른 경우만 매칭(행사 보도 공통).
6장: 2025 합계출산율 0.80(잠정, 국가데이터처 2026-02-25). 혼외출산 비중 한 자릿수(2024년 5.8%).
9장: 세금으로 연애 주선, 스펙 검증 논란 등 비판 보도.
